name: create_vfx_texture
description: Generate a pixelated VFX texture: a bright hot core fading to cool edges in quantized colour bands with jagged transparent edges — the look of pixel flames/energy/projectiles. With frames>1 it bakes a vertical FLIPBOOK and starts the animation player so the effect loops. Defaults to an additive/emissive render mode + 2-sided rendering so it glows on a plane. Apply it to add_plane planes (crossed/layered) and animate with bones. See get_guide topic 'vfx'.

frame_interpolate.description: Blend between frames (default false for crisp pixels).

frames.description: Flipbook frame count (default 1 = static). 4-8 for a looping animation.

height.description: Frame height px (default 16, or 24 for flame/beam).

soft_edge.description: Fade the coolest band's alpha (default true for orb/glow/smoke).
